results.identificationRemarks: from Ian Kitching: "From the rather rounded outer edge to the forewings, I would say this is Hippotion rosetta. It is a lttle better marked than in general but still not "stripy" enough for boerhaviae in my opinion. The hindwing colour would have helped; ther isn't enough to be sure. Rosetta is generally more common than boerhaviae and certainly the more "weedy" species, with boerhaviae tending to be more a forest species." Jean Haxaire: "For me this is rosetta."
